transforms.reason: Races where intermediate or wet tyres were used are excluded: wet running is a different tyre problem. Rain on slicks is handled lap by lap (drop_rain).
No lap time recorded, so the lap cannot be modelled. Totals over all dry races.
Lap 1 starts from a standstill; its time measures the start, not tyre wear. Totals over all dry races.
The lap is not inside any stint, so compound and tyre age are unknown. Totals over all dry races.
Out-lap: includes the pit exit and cold tyres, not racing pace. Totals over all dry races.
In-lap: includes slowing for the pit entry, not racing pace. Totals over all dry races.
Safety Car, Virtual Safety Car or red flag during the lap (or the restart lap after it): everyone drives a set slow pace, which says nothing about the tyres. Totals over all dry races.
Rain was falling (weather feed) when the lap started: a wet track on slicks, not tyre wear. Totals over all dry races.
Median gap to the car ahead during the lap under 1 s: dirty air slows the car and overheats the tyres, which would be mistaken for wear. Totals over all dry races.
More than 5 s slower than the stint's median lap: spins, damage, blue flags or long battles, not gradual wear. Totals over all dry races.
